package.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。

en-US.description: A desktop AI companion that connects any model, does the work itself, and delegates specialist jobs to coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Nomi is an AI companion living on your desktop: bring any model, let it do the work, and let it hand specialist jobs to specialist AIs. Models, coding agents, MCP and local tools all connect in one place, coordinated by Nomi.
Connect a model once and every AI can use it: after adding a provider, Nomi itself plus Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and dsh can use any of its models, or everything can switch to local models. The local gateway detects and translates between Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini generateContent, so streaming, tool calls, reasoning, images and context compaction keep working.
Tasks can be limited to specific folders, coding assistants get a two-column workspace, and the desktop mascot shows speech and confirmation bubbles. The app runs on a Go core with the native WebView, installs per user without administrator rights, and needs the Edge WebView2 runtime, which is usually preinstalled on Windows 10 and 11.

zh-CN.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Nomi 是住在你桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己动手干活，也会把专业的活派给专业的 AI。模型、编程助手、MCP 与本地工具都接到一处，由 Nomi 统一调度。
模型只接一次就能给所有 AI 使用：添加一次供应商，Nomi 自己和 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok、dsh 都能用它的任意模型，也可以全部换成本地模型。本机网关自动识别并互转 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses、OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Gemini generateContent，流式、工具调用、推理、图片和上下文压缩都照常工作。
任务可以限定能访问的文件夹，编程助手有独立的两栏工作区，桌面角色会显示台词与确认气泡。应用为 Go 内核加原生 WebView，单个安装包约 39 MB，按当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限。
zh-CN.name: Nomi
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Nomi· 诺米 2.3.4
Nomi 跑长任务更稳：按模型实际用掉的上下文来管理，快满时自动腾地方，计划没做完会接着做；子任务改过的文件和生成的图片都会回到对话里。 / Nomi handles long tasks more reliably: context is managed by what the model actually used and space is freed automatically before it fills up, and unfinished plans get finished; files a sub-task changed and images it generated now come back to the chat.
新功能 / New
- 设置新增「关于」页：版本与检查更新、项目主页、更新历史、近期更新和问题反馈；更新相关的开关收进「更新设置」弹窗 / Settings has a new About page with the version and update check, the homepage, release history, recent updates and feedback; update toggles move into an Update settings dialog
- 「知识 · 记忆 · 日程」（侧栏底部、输入框「+」菜单、Ctrl/⌘+Shift+M）改为从右侧抽屉打开，不再跳到设置页 / Knowledge · Memory · Schedule (sidebar, the input's "+" menu, Ctrl/⌘+Shift+M) now opens in a right-side drawer instead of jumping to Settings
- /compact 后面可以写要优先保留的重点，如 /compact 重点保留接口设计 / /compact accepts what to focus on, e.g. /compact keep the API design
- 执行轨迹和 /context 里能看到上一轮的提示缓存命中率 / The execution trace and /context show the last reply's prompt cache hit rate
改进 / Improvements
- 长任务不再因为上下文撑满中途失败：一轮里连续调工具时每一步按实际用量检查，快满时先缩短较早的大段工具输出，还不够就把较早的步骤压成摘要接着做；模型仍提示超长时自动压短重试一次 / Long tasks no longer fail midway because the context filled up: during a run of tool calls each step is checked against actual usage, older long tool outputs are shortened first and earlier steps are summarized if needed, and a request rejected as too long is retried once with shorter content
- 对话接近一半时，较早几轮的大段工具输出只留开头和结尾，对话原文能保留得更久、晚一些才需要压缩 / Once a chat is about halfway full, long tool outputs from older turns keep only their beginning and end, so the original conversation lasts longer before it has to be compacted
- 自动压缩按上一轮实际用掉的上下文判断；摘要分节写，并补上最近读过或改过的文件、最近的计划和用过的技能 / Auto-compaction uses the context the last reply actually used; summaries are sectioned and followed by recently read or changed files, the latest plan and loaded skills
- 更省钱、更快：按需提供的工具在一个对话里开过就一直提供，前几轮的思考内容不再随历史重发，提示缓存不容易被打断 / Cheaper and faster: tools offered once in a chat stay offered and earlier reasoning is no longer resent, so the prompt cache breaks less often
- 计划没做完就不收尾：这一轮的计划还有没做完的步骤时，Nomi 会接着做，或者说明哪步做不了；自动续做时没有实际进展就停下，不再空转 / Unfinished plans get finished: if the turn's plan still has open steps Nomi keeps going or says which step can't be done, and automatic continuation stops when it isn't making real progress
- 工具输出很长时 Nomi 先看开头和结尾，需要时再分页读中间；命令输出超过上限时保留结尾，报错和失败的测试不会被截掉 / Very long tool output is read by its beginning and end first and the middle in pages when needed; command output over the limit keeps its end, so errors and failing tests are no longer cut off
- 生图服务暂时出错（网络、超时、限流、服务端错误）时自动重试两次，图已生成只是下载失败时只重新下载 / Image generation retries twice on temporary errors (network, timeout, rate limit, server error), and only re-downloads when the image was made but the download failed
- 后台的 Nomi 任务按所用模型的上下文窗口计算预算，不再固定 8K / Background Nomi tasks size their context budget from the model's window instead of a fixed 8K
修复 / Fixes
- 子任务做完后，它改动的文件和生成的图片会随结果回到对话，Nomi 下一轮也能读到；派给后台 Nomi 的生图任务只出图、没写总结时不再判为失败 / When a sub-task finishes, the files it changed and the images it generated come back to the chat with the result and Nomi can read them next turn; an image task handed to background Nomi that produced images but no summary no longer counts as failed
- 后台的 Nomi 和知识库问答用你提问的语言回复，不再固定用中文 / Background Nomi and knowledge-base answers reply in the language you asked in instead of always Chinese
- 忘记记忆是真的忘记：删掉一段对话摘要时，从它整理出的「关于我」条目一起删掉，之后也不会再被整理回来 / Forgetting memory sticks: deleting a conversation summary also deletes the "About me" entries extracted from it, and they are not extracted again later
- 对话中途换成云端模型时，之前本地模型读到的文件内容、命令输出和网页内容会按「仅本地模型可读文件」重新判断，不再随历史发给云端 / When a chat switches to a cloud model midway, file contents, command output and web pages read earlier by a local model are checked again against "only local models can read files" instead of being sent along with the history
- 在「桌面权限 → 隐私保护」撤销「始终允许」后，原来授权的标签下一轮不再带着这项沙箱授权 / After revoking "Always allow" in Desktop permissions → Privacy, the tab that granted it no longer keeps the sandbox grant on its next turn
- 子任务栏里排队的消息只发给它自己的子任务，按发送顺序送达，切换子任务时不再发错 / Messages queued in the sub-task column go only to their own sub-task, in the order sent, and no longer go to another sub-task after switching
